写一个程序「计算器」。计算器：从标准输入一行一行读算式，每行输出一行结果
支持整数和小数、+ - * /、括号、负号（如 -(2+3)、2*-3）
变量：「x = 算式」给变量赋值并输出它的值，之后的算式可以用变量
结果是整数就不带小数点（10/2 输出 5），否则最多 4 位小数、去掉末尾的 0（7/2 输出 3.5，1/3 输出 0.3333）
出错时输出一行错误并继续下一行：除以零输出「错误：除以零」；用了没赋值的变量输出「错误：未定义 变量名」；其他写错的算式输出「错误：语法」
读输入用 io.read()，读到 nil 就结束。写好后保存并测试。

-- @about 计算器：从标准输入一行一行读算式，每行输出一行结果
-- 支持整数和小数、+ - * /、括号、负号（如 -(2+3)、2*-3）
-- 变量：「x = 算式」给变量赋值并输出它的值，之后的算式可以用变量
-- 结果是整数就不带小数点（10/2 输出 5），否则最多 4 位小数、去掉末尾的 0（7/2 输出 3.5，1/3 输出 0.3333）
-- 出错时输出一行错误并继续下一行：除以零输出「错误：除以零」；用了没赋值的变量输出「错误：未定义 变量名」；其他写错的算式输出「错误：语法」
local vars = {}

local function fmt(v)
  if v == math.floor(v) then return string.format("%d", v) end
  local s = string.format("%.4f", v):gsub("0+$", "")
  return s
end

local function eval(src)
  local pos = 1
  local function skip()
    while src:sub(pos, pos) == " " do pos = pos + 1 end
  end
  local expr
  local function atom()
    skip()
    local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
    if c == "(" then
      pos = pos + 1
      local v = expr()
      skip()
      if src:sub(pos, pos) ~= ")" then error("语法", 0) end
      pos = pos + 1
      return v
    end
    if c == "-" then pos = pos + 1 return -atom() end
    local num = src:match("^%d+%.?%d*", pos)
    if num then
      pos = pos + #num
      return tonumber(num)
    end
    local name = src:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", pos)
    if name then
      pos = pos + #name
      if vars[name] == nil then error("未定义 " .. name, 0) end
      return vars[name]
    end
    error("语法", 0)
  end
  local function term()
    local v = atom()
    while true do
      skip()
      local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
      if c == "*" then
        pos = pos + 1
        v = v * atom()
      elseif c == "/" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local d = atom()
        if d == 0 then error("除以零", 0) end
        v = v / d
      else
        return v
      end
    end
  end
  expr = function()
    local v = term()
    while true do
      skip()
      local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
      if c == "+" then
        pos = pos + 1
        v = v + term()
      elseif c == "-" then
        pos = pos + 1
        v = v - term()
      else
        return v
      end
    end
  end
  local v = expr()
  skip()
  if pos <= #src then error("语法", 0) end
  return v
end

while true do
  local line = io.read()
  if not line then break end
  local name, rhs = line:match("^%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.+)$")
  local ok, v = pcall(eval, rhs or line)
  if ok then
    if name then vars[name] = v end
    print(fmt(v))
  else
    print("错误：" .. tostring(v))
  end
end

-- @about 库存：从标准输入读命令，每条命令输出一行（list 可能多行）
-- 命令：
--   add 名称 数量 单价   数量累加，单价更新，输出 ok
--   remove 名称 数量     库存不够输出「错误：库存不足」且不改动；正好取完是可以的，条目保留（数量 0）；成功输出 ok
--   price 名称 单价      改单价，输出 ok
--   total                所有货物 数量×单价 的总和
--   list                 每个货物一行「名称 数量 单价」，按名称升序；没有货物输出「空」
--   low N                数量小于 N 的名称，按名称升序用逗号连接；没有输出「无」
-- 没有这个货物输出「错误：没有 名称」；数量、单价不是数字或是负数输出「错误：参数」；其他命令输出「错误：不认识的命令」
-- 数字的写法：整数不带小数点，否则最多 2 位小数、去掉末尾的 0
local items = {}

local function fmt(v)
  if v == math.floor(v) then return string.format("%d", v) end
  local s = string.format("%.2f", v):gsub("0+$", "")
  return s
end

local function num(s)
  local v = tonumber(s)
  if not v or v < 0 then return nil end
  return v
end

local function names()
  local list = {}
  for name in pairs(items) do list[#list + 1] = name end
  table.sort(list)
  return list
end

local commands = {}

function commands.add(name, count, price)
  count, price = num(count), num(price)
  if not name or not count or not price then return "错误：参数" end
  local item = items[name] or { count = 0 }
  item.count = item.count + count
  item.price = price
  items[name] = item
  return "ok"
end

function commands.remove(name, count)
  count = num(count)
  if not name or not count then return "错误：参数" end
  local item = items[name]
  if not item then return "错误：没有 " .. name end
  if item.count < count then return "错误：库存不足" end
  item.count = item.count - count
  return "ok"
end

function commands.price(name, price)
  price = num(price)
  if not name or not price then return "错误：参数" end
  if not items[name] then return "错误：没有 " .. name end
  items[name].price = price
  return "ok"
end

function commands.total()
  local sum = 0
  for _, item in pairs(items) do sum = sum + item.count * item.price end
  return fmt(sum)
end

function commands.list()
  local lines = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(names()) do
    lines[#lines + 1] = name .. " " .. fmt(items[name].count) .. " " .. fmt(items[name].price)
  end
  return #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "空"
end

function commands.low(n)
  n = num(n)
  if not n then return "错误：参数" end
  local found = {}
  for _, name in ipairs(names()) do
    if items[name].count < n then found[#found + 1] = name end
  end
  return #found > 0 and table.concat(found, ",") or "无"
end

while true do
  local line = io.read()
  if not line then break end
  local words = {}
  for w in line:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
  local run = commands[words[1] or ""]
  if run then print(run(table.unpack(words, 2))) else print("错误：不认识的命令") end
end

-- @about 冒险：文字冒险，从标准输入读命令，每条命令输出一行
local rooms = {
  ["大厅"] = { exits = { "厨房", "地下室" }, items = {} },
  ["厨房"] = { exits = { "大厅" }, items = { "钥匙" } },
  ["地下室"] = { exits = { "大厅" }, items = { "宝箱" } },
}
local here, bag, steps = "大厅", {}, 0

local function has(list, x)
  for i, v in ipairs(list) do
    if v == x then return i end
  end
end

local commands = {}

commands["看"] = function()
  local room = rooms[here]
  local text = "你在" .. here .. "。出口：" .. table.concat(room.exits, "、") .. "。"
  if #room.items > 0 then text = text .. "这里有：" .. table.concat(room.items, "、") .. "。" end
  return text
end

commands["去"] = function(where)
  if not where or not has(rooms[here].exits, where) then return "去不了。" end
  if where == "地下室" and not has(bag, "钥匙") then return "门锁着。" end
  here = where
  steps = steps + 1
  return "你来到" .. where .. "。"
end

commands["拿"] = function(what)
  local i = what and has(rooms[here].items, what)
  if not i then return "这里没有" .. tostring(what or "") .. "。" end
  if what == "宝箱" then return "太重了。" end
  table.remove(rooms[here].items, i)
  bag[#bag + 1] = what
  return "拿到" .. what .. "。"
end

commands["背包"] = function()
  return "背包：" .. (#bag > 0 and table.concat(bag, "、") or "空")
end

commands["开"] = function(what)
  if what ~= "宝箱" or not has(rooms[here].items, "宝箱") then return "这里没有" .. tostring(what or "") .. "。" end
  return "你赢了！用了 " .. steps .. " 步。", true
end

while true do
  local line = io.read()
  if not line then break end
  local verb, arg = line:match("^%s*(%S+)%s*(%S*)")
  local run = commands[verb or ""]
  if not run then
    print("听不懂。")
  else
    local text, done = run(arg ~= "" and arg or nil)
    print(text)
    if done then break end
  end
end

--   cal list                  按开始时间每行「HH:MM-HH:MM 名称」；没有事项输出「空」
--   cal next HH:MM            开始时间不早于它的第一个事项「HH:MM 名称」；没有输出「无」
--   cal free                  08:00 到 22:00 之间的空闲时段，按时间先后每段一行「HH:MM-HH:MM」；没有输出「无」
--   其他命令输出「错误：不认识的命令」
--
-- calc 计算器（calc 后面是一个算式）
--   支持整数和小数、+ - * /、括号、负号（如 -(2+3)、2*-3）
--   「calc x = 算式」给变量赋值并输出它的值，之后的算式可以用变量

local handlers = {}

  local events = {}

  local function parse(t)
    local h, m = (t or ""):match("^(%d%d):(%d%d)$")
    h, m = tonumber(h), tonumber(m)
    if not h or h > 23 or m > 59 then return nil end
    return h * 60 + m
  end

  local function show(minutes)
    return string.format("%02d:%02d", minutes // 60, minutes % 60)
  end

  local function sorted()
    local list = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(events) do list[#list + 1] = e end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.s < b.s end)
    return list
  end

  local commands = {}

  function commands.add(name, from, to)
    local s, e = parse(from), parse(to)
    if not name or not s or not e or e <= s then return "错误：时间" end
    for _, other in ipairs(sorted()) do
      if s < other.e and other.s < e then return "冲突：" .. other.name end
    end
    events[#events + 1] = { name = name, s = s, e = e }
    return "ok"
  end

  function commands.del(name)
    for i, e in ipairs(events) do
      if e.name == name then
        table.remove(events, i)
        return "ok"
      end
    end
    return "错误：没有 " .. tostring(name)
  end

    local lines = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(sorted()) do lines[#lines + 1] = show(e.s) .. "-" .. show(e.e) .. " " .. e.name end
    return #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "空"
  end

  function commands.next(at)
    local t = parse(at)
    if not t then return "错误：时间" end
    for _, e in ipairs(sorted()) do
      if e.s >= t then return show(e.s) .. " " .. e.name end
    end
    return "无"
  end

    return #lines > 0 and table.concat(lines, "\n") or "无"
  end

  handlers.cal = function(line)
    local words = {}
    for w in line:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
    local run = commands[words[1] or ""]
    if run then return run(table.unpack(words, 2)) end
    return "错误：不认识的命令"
  end

do
  local vars = {}

  local function fmt(v)
    if v == math.floor(v) then return string.format("%d", v) end
    local s = string.format("%.4f", v):gsub("0+$", "")
    return s
  end

  local function eval(src)
    local pos = 1
    local function skip()

    end
    local expr
    local function atom()
      skip()
      local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
      if c == "(" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local v = expr()
        skip()
        if src:sub(pos, pos) ~= ")" then error("语法", 0) end
        pos = pos + 1
        return v
      end
      if c == "-" then pos = pos + 1 return -atom() end
      local num = src:match("^%d+%.?%d*", pos)

        pos = pos + #num
        return tonumber(num)
      end
      local name = src:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", pos)
      if name then
        pos = pos + #name
        if vars[name] == nil then error("未定义 " .. name, 0) end
        return vars[name]
      end
      error("语法", 0)
    end
    local function term()
      local v = atom()
      while true do
        skip()
        local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
        if c == "*" then
          pos = pos + 1
          v = v * atom()
        elseif c == "/" then
          pos = pos + 1
          local d = atom()
          if d == 0 then error("除以零", 0) end
          v = v / d
        else
          return v

      end

        if c == "+" then
          pos = pos + 1
          v = v + term()
        elseif c == "-" then

        else

    end

    local name, rhs = line:match("^%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.+)$")

  local module, rest = line:match("^%s*(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
  local handle = handlers[module or ""]
  print(handle and handle(rest) or "错误：不认识的模块")

    for w in line:gmatch("%S+") do words[#words + 1] = w end
    local run = commands[words[1] or ""]
    if run then return run(table.unpack(words, 2)) end
    return "错误：不认识的命令"
  end
end

-- ---- 计算器
do
  local vars = {}

  local function fmt(v)
    if v == math.floor(v) then return string.format("%d", v) end
    local s = string.format("%.4f", v):gsub("0+$", "")
    return s
  end

  local function eval(src)
    local pos = 1
    local function skip()
      while src:sub(pos, pos) == " " do pos = pos + 1 end
    end
    local expr
    local function atom()
      skip()
      local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
      if c == "(" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local v = expr()
        skip()
        if src:sub(pos, pos) ~= ")" then error("语法", 0) end
        pos = pos + 1
        return v
      end
      if c == "-" then pos = pos + 1 return -atom() end
      local num = src:match("^%d+%.?%d*", pos)
      if num then
        pos = pos + #num
        return tonumber(num)
      end
      local name = src:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", pos)
      if name then
        pos = pos + #name
        if vars[name] == nil then error("未定义 " .. name, 0) end
        return vars[name]
      end
      error("语法", 0)
    end
    local function term()
      local v = atom()
      while true do
        skip()
        local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
        if c == "*" then
          pos = pos + 1
          v = v * atom()
        elseif c == "/" then
          pos = pos + 1
          local d = atom()
          if d == 0 then error("除以零", 0) end
          v = v / d
        else
          return v
        end
      end
    end
    expr = function()
      local v = term()
      while true do
        skip()
        local c = src:sub(pos, pos)
        if c == "+" then
          pos = pos + 1
          v = v + term()
        elseif c == "-" then
          pos = pos + 1
          v = v - term()
        else
          return v
        end
      end
    end
    local v = expr()
    skip()
    if pos <= #src then error("语法", 0) end
    return v
  end

  handlers.calc = function(line)
    local name, rhs = line:match("^%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.+)$")
    local ok, v = pcall(eval, rhs or line)
    if ok then
      if name then vars[name] = v end
      return fmt(v)
    end
    return "错误：" .. tostring(v)
  end
end

while true do
  local line = io.read()
  if not line then break end
  local module, rest = line:match("^%s*(%S+)%s*(.*)$")
  local handle = handlers[module or ""]
  print(handle and handle(rest) or "错误：不认识的模块")
end
